description: Reference pages consulted to derive docs/contract.json. VCF Automation (VCF 9.1) does not publish a machine-readable API specification in the vmware/vcf-api-specs repository, so the contract was derived by reading the xAPIs reference documentation hosted on the Broadcom Developer Portal. Each entry records the page URL, the contract operation (or schema) it documents, and the date the page was fetched.
product: VMware Cloud Foundation 9.1 - VCF Automation, VM Apps organization

sources.title: Org Management - VM Apps Org
sources.documents: auth.token.exchange - POST /tm/oauth/tenant/{tenant}/token; the OAuth refresh-token grant used to obtain a bearer access token for the VM Apps organization APIs, and the index of VM Apps Org API groups.

sources.title: VM Apps Org - Deployment, operation index
sources.documents: Operation inventory for the Deployment service; used to establish the exact method/path of every deployment, request, event, log and resource operation carried in the contract.

sources.title: Get Deployments
sources.documents: deployments.list - GET /deployment/api/deployments; full query-parameter set, types, defaults and the lastRequestStatus enum.

sources.title: Get Deployment Requests
sources.documents: deployments.requests.list - GET /deployment/api/deployments/{deploymentId}/requests; path and query parameters, PageRequest envelope and deployment request field names.

sources.title: Submit Deployment Action Request
sources.documents: deployments.requests.submitAction - POST /deployment/api/deployments/{deploymentId}/requests; the request body schema (actionId, inputs, reason, all optional) and response codes.

sources.title: Get Deployment Resources
sources.documents: deployments.resources.list - GET /deployment/api/deployments/{deploymentId}/resources; path and query parameters and the PageDeploymentResource envelope.

sources.title: Get Request
sources.documents: requests.get - GET /deployment/api/requests/{requestId}; confirms the operation takes no query parameters, and gives the Request field set plus the request status enum.

sources.title: Action Deployment Request (cancel / dismiss)
sources.documents: requests.action - POST /deployment/api/requests/{requestId}; the required 'action' query parameter with values cancel and dismiss, and the absence of a request body.

sources.title: Get Request Events
sources.documents: requests.events.list - GET /deployment/api/requests/{requestId}/events; path and query parameters and the event field set (details, hasLogs, id, name, resourceName, resourceType, timestamp, userEvent).

sources.title: Get Event Logs
sources.documents: requests.events.logs.get - GET /deployment/api/requests/{requestId}/events/{eventId}/logs; the optional sinceRow query parameter and the SliceEventLog envelope with log entry fields (eof, id, message, rownum, timestamp).

sources.title: Deployment data structure
sources.documents: Field names and optionality of the Deployment object returned by deployments.list.

sources.title: DeploymentResource data structure
sources.documents: Field names and optionality of the DeploymentResource object returned by deployments.resources.list, including the origin, state and syncStatus enums.

sources.title: VM Apps Org - Access Control, operation index
sources.documents: Consulted for authentication alternatives (sessions and tokens operations). Not carried into the contract: the OAuth refresh-token grant documented on the Org Management - VM Apps Org page is the mechanism this contract uses.

sources.title: Provider Infrastructure APIs
sources.documents: Background only: portal-wide VCF Automation 9.1 conventions (JSON payloads, bearer authorization, HATEOAS links, asynchronous 202 + Location tracking). No operation in the contract is derived from this page.
